trends.description: Customer mentions of 'battery health' up 400% in March. Exact percentage now mandatory expectation across all platforms. Even peer-to-peer sellers required to disclose.
trends.impact: Critical - must display exact battery percentages and guarantee minimums prominently on all listings
trends.opportunity: Lead market with battery health data, offer battery replacement services, create comprehensive battery health guides
trends.evolution: Now mandatory on Swappa, becoming standard across all platforms. Cycle counts and charging history becoming differentiators.
trends.latest_insight: Customers specifically asking for '85%+ battery health minimum' as baseline expectation

trends.description: iPhone 16 rumors accelerating current-gen price drops despite September release still 6 months away. Spec leaks causing purchase delays.
trends.impact: High - creates urgency messaging opportunity while managing price decline expectations
trends.opportunity: Frame current pricing as 'perfect timing' before next wave of upgrades, emphasize immediate satisfaction vs waiting
trends.latest: Leak of iPhone 16 Pro specs causing iPhone 14/15 holders to delay purchases, increasing refurb supply

trends.description: March showing highest refurb supply levels in 6+ months as customers upgrade during spring cleaning season. Supply up 23% week-over-week.
trends.impact: High - best selection and pricing power window of the year
trends.opportunity: Aggressive inventory acquisition while prices at absolute lowest point before summer demand
trends.latest: Grade A inventory up 31% - customers upgrading in better condition than usual, premium supply available
trends.timing: Window closes March 20th as spring sales end

trends.description: Massive customer confusion intensifying: 'unlocked' definitions, Verizon/AT&T/T-Mobile compatibility, 5G band support
trends.impact: High - creating purchase hesitation and returns from compatibility issues
trends.opportunity: Position as compatibility experts with clear carrier guides and guaranteed compatibility promises
trends.source: Reddit threads showing daily questions: 'does unlocked mean it works on Verizon too?'

trends.description: Lightning vs USB-C confusion, case compatibility across iPhone models, wireless charging standards creating decision paralysis
trends.impact: High - creating purchase hesitation and returns from wrong accessories
trends.opportunity: Create definitive compatibility guides, offer guaranteed-compatible bundles, build trust through expertise
trends.evolution: Now includes specific questions: 'will my case from my old phone fit this model', 'do I need a different charger'
trends.solution: Bundle deals with guaranteed compatibility become major differentiator

trends.description: Multiple competitors launching 'like-new' premium tiers at 85-90% of retail prices, creating two-tier market
trends.impact: Medium - creates opportunity to own true value position vs premium positioning chase
trends.opportunity: Emphasize real savings and value rather than chasing premium margins - let others fight for premium tier
trends.insight: Premium tiers make standard refurb look like better value - use this positioning advantage

trends.description: Growing customer concern about Face ID/Touch ID reliability on refurbished devices, including mask compatibility
trends.impact: Medium - requires specific quality assurance messaging and testing guarantees
trends.opportunity: Guarantee biometric function testing, offer replacement if biometrics fail, test mask compatibility
trends.addition: Specific concerns: Face ID with masks, Touch ID sensitivity, depth sensor functionality
